formula.matchup: For same-position opponent appearances this season before forecast week, compare each version's stat value with that player's other admitted earlier-week season games; admit similarity mean within0.5–2.0×target season mean (startup min-pick threshold if no mean). raw=sum(values)/sum(other-game means); factor=round(clip(1+(raw-1)*n/(n+8),0.75,1.25),3); output=round(base*factor,2).
